page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at a clock speed of 2.9 GHz. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per virtual core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It also lacks dedicated GPU hardware, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. For network connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps, which supports standard data transfer requirements between cloud resources.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7se.16xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for enterprise workloads that require significant multi-core processing power without the premium cost of specialized memory-optimized or GPU-accelerated hardware. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance for multi-threaded applications. Appropriate workloads include enterprise application hosting, medium-to-large web serving fleets, container orchestration nodes, and general-purpose database hosting.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7se.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of RAM. Powered by Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this KVM-based instance maintains a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The hardware configuration lacks local storage and GPU accelerators, meaning workloads must rely on network-attached storage and CPU-based execution. It delivers a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps. This resource profile is designed for enterprise applications, web serving, and containerized environments that require stable, dedicated compute resources without the need for specialized hardware.
